statistic.title: Objets : répartition par type
statistic.comment: Cet état affiche le nombre d'enregistrements pour chacun des types définis dans la base de données. Les types d'objets non utilisés ne sont pas affichés.
statistic.sql: select ca_l_i.idno as "Type", count(*) as "Nombre" from ca_objects ca_o left join ca_list_items ca_l_i on ca_o.type_id=ca_l_i.item_id and ca_l_i.parent_id is not null left join ca_lists ca_l on ca_l.list_id=ca_l_i.list_id where ca_o.deleted = 0 group by ca_l_i.item_id order by 2 desc

statistic.title: Objets créés par mois cette année
statistic.sql: SELECT year(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) AS année,monthname(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) as mois, concat(count(DISTINCT logged_row_id))+0 as opération FROM `ca_change_log` cal where cal.logged_table_num=57 and changetype="I" and year(NOW()) = year(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) GROUP BY année,mois ORDER BY année,month(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime))

statistic.title: Objets par statut
statistic.sql: SELECT ca_li.idno as Statut, count(ca_o.object_id) as Nombre FROM ca_objects ca_o LEFT JOIN ca_list_items ca_li ON ca_li.item_value = ca_o.status LEFT JOIN ca_lists ca_l ON ca_li.list_id=ca_l.list_id WHERE ca_l.list_code='workflow_statuses' and ca_li.item_value!="Root" and ca_o.deleted = 0 group by ca_li.item_value

statistic.title: Objets par droit d'accès
statistic.sql: SELECT ca_li.idno as Access, count(ca_o.object_id) as Number FROM ca_objects ca_o LEFT JOIN ca_list_items ca_li ON ca_li.item_value = ca_o.access LEFT JOIN ca_lists ca_l ON ca_li.list_id=ca_l.list_id WHERE ca_l.list_code='access_statuses' and ca_li.item_value!="Root" and ca_o.deleted = 0 group by ca_li.item_value

statistic.title: Objets supprimés
statistic.sql: SELECT IF(deleted>0,"yes","no") as "Supprimés", count(object_id) as Nombre FROM ca_objects GROUP BY deleted
